description: What happened historically after the Bitcoin cycle looked like this? Conditional forward-return distribution for a named preset cycle state — over N DISTINCT historical episodes matching that state (matched_episodes), returns median/IQR/positive-share forward returns (30/90/180/365d) with per-horizon n, small-n warnings, point-in-time integrity and an `evidence` block for the sample-size gate. A distribution with its sample size. Not obtainable from web search or public market-data APIs — requires point-in-time indicator history and look-ahead-free episode matching. Presets: cycle_bottom_cluster (Cycle bottom cluster), cycle_top_cluster (Cycle top cluster), deep_fear (Deep fear), euphoria (Euphoria), quiet_volatility (Quiet volatility regime). The response carries preset_definition, current_state_matches, last_matching_date, study_finding (where a study exists) and vs_unconditional_drift — drift_note and semantics_note in the payload say how to read them. For quiet_volatility, vol_rank_threshold (fixed steps 5/10/20/50) asks the stricter "UNUSUALLY quiet" question the null study left open, and condition_on_direction conditions episodes on the sign of the first post-anchor move over direction_window_days (default 5). Also works for asset=ETH/SOL (F2 cycle history), but only price-derived presets (cycle_bottom_cluster, cycle_top_cluster) — fear-greed and volatility presets are BTC-only. Set include_path=true (BTC, predicate presets) to add "path_statistics": what happened ON THE WAY — MAE/MFE, days to trough, days under water (total and longest unbroken streak), days to first recovery — over the SAME episodes as forward_returns. Related: arena_get_volatility_history (the series behind the volatility preset), arena_get_cycle (the current state to compare against), arena_dip_scenario (composes this base rate into a tranche structure). [API Pro tier]

asset.description: Which asset’s cycle history. Default BTC. ETH/SOL support only price-derived presets (cycle_bottom_cluster, cycle_top_cluster).

condition_on_direction.description: quiet_volatility only. Condition episodes on the direction of the FIRST post-anchor move (sign of the direction_window_days-day return). Horizons <= direction_window_days are suppressed as circular. Sets study_finding_applies=false.

direction_window_days.description: Classification window for condition_on_direction (default 5). Only meaningful together with condition_on_direction.

forward_horizons.description: Forward-return horizons in days (max 20). Default [30, 90, 180, 365] — except for quiet_volatility, which defaults to the horizons its study actually tested ([30, 90, 180]); anything beyond that is flagged as outside the protocol.

include_path.description: Default false. true adds path_statistics per horizon (MAE/MFE, days under water, longest under-water streak, days to first recovery) over the same episodes as forward_returns. BTC and predicate presets only (not quiet_volatility, not ETH/SOL in v1).

preset.description: Named ex-ante cycle-state condition set. One of: cycle_bottom_cluster, cycle_top_cluster, deep_fear, euphoria, quiet_volatility.

vol_rank_threshold.description: quiet_volatility only. Reference threshold as a FIXED step: 50 (default, below trailing median — the studied definition) or 5/10/20 (unusually quiet: RV30 below its trailing Nth percentile). Any value other than 50 sets study_finding_applies=false — the null study covered only the default.

name: arena_get_historical_analog
title: Historical analog — conditional forward returns
